Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular everyday, high-value picks are pure beeswax tea lights and beeswax tapers.
Tea lights are the easiest daily-use option (quick to light, low maintenance) and great for a steady glow in shorter bursts. Tapers give you a longer burn and a classic dinner/evening vibe, but they do best with a proper holder and a draft‑free spot.
